usedFor: A “New Record” in ActivityInfo saves a file to a Dropbox folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Record” in ActivityInfo, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: It files the record's attachment from its link and lets you add, replace or update duplicates.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public web link, and “Updated Record” can rerun on filed records.
